reviewText: Sistine Decorating transformed our Dartmouth home. Friendly, clean, and totally reliable. The quality of the finish on our walls and woodwork is fantastic. We will definitely use them again.
Living right on the water in Kingswear, our exterior paint takes a beating from the weather. Sistine did an exceptional job preparing the masonry and painting the whole frontage. Looks pristine.
Punctual, tidy, and great attention to detail. The wallpapering in our dining room is immaculate. Highly recommended to anyone in the Dartmouth and South Hams area.
